text:
elaine-sales: Hey team — Jordan (customer) is starting a 30-day POC tomorrow. They need a hosted API key that we can rotate/revoke quickly if needed. Requirements: scoped to the POC, expiry after 30 days, audit trail, ability to revoke immediately, and IP allowlist. Any blocking issues?

sam-se: we can create a scoped POC key from the Console under Projects -> API Keys. choose role 'poc-limited' and set TTL. we can also tag it for billing.

elaine-sales: can we set TTL to 30 days and auto-rotate once at 15d? customer asked about rotation best practice.

sam-se: console only supports expiry, not automated mid-ttl rotation. for rotation we recommend issuing a short-lived key (7-30d) + automation that calls the Admin Keys API to create a new key and update the app. we have a sample script.

jordan-customer: can you show the curl for using the key and how to rotate? we want to wire it into our CI.

sam-se: sure — example usage: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer RWD-POC-xxxxx" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
For rotation: create new key via Admin API, deploy into their CI secret manager, then call revoke on the old key. pseudo: 
```
# create
POST /v1/admin/keys {"project":"acme-poc","role":"poc-limited"}
# revoke
POST /v1/admin/keys/<old_key>/revoke
```
(we'll share the real endpoints and client snippet in the docs)

karen-sec: small sec notes: • token must be scoped to minimal perms • enable IP allowlist for their static egress ranges • disable model telemetry/logging for the POC (customer requested) • require audit logs retention 90d for the contract review. also prefer per-environment keys (staging/prod) not a single shared key.

elaine-sales: they asked for a single 'team' key to make it easy for devs. is that acceptable?

karen-sec: acceptable if we enforce IP allowlist + short TTL + require rotation through CI. we should also tag the key with 'sales_poc:acme' and link to the security questionnaire id.

ops-engr: FYI there is a cache propagation window when revoking keys (~30s) because of edge caches. immediate rejection for fresh connections, but long-lived connections may need to re-auth. plan for that with the customer.

deploy-bot: API key created: RWD-POC-8f3b2 (tag=acme-poc, ttl=30d, created_by=elaine-sales) :white_check_mark:

jordan-customer: got it — we'll put the key in our CI vault and swap if you send the rotate script. can you also add the IP allowlist now?

sam-se: added IP ranges to the key entry. sending rotate script in a follow-up thread. we'll also add step-by-step revoke instructions and the Admin API sample token flow.

elaine-sales: perfect. pls add the security questionnaire reference and billing tag before EOD. thanks :pray:

karen-sec: noted — i'll append the questionnaire id (SQ-4821) to the key metadata and confirm audit log retention with infra.

jordan-customer: thanks everyone, appreciate the quick turnaround.
